name: Exterior Trim Repaint Condition Assessment
intent: Fixed-time condition assessment: DSD rating per component, adhesion test, moisture test, rot probe, and lead test (pre-1978).
doctrine: Fixed-time assessment tasks. DSD (Deterioration Severity Description) rating drives condition modifier and prep scope. Adhesion and moisture tests verify coating compatibility. Rot probe at horizontal surfaces (sills, band boards). Lead test only for pre-1978 buildings.
